title: Potato Fry
method: Start by boiling, peeling and then chopping your potatoes into your favorite size pieces

Add in your potatoes and coat them lightly follow that up with haldi, red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala and aamchur powder.

caption:
MY POTATO FRY RECIPE

Ingredients
3 Potatoes, boiled, peeled and chopped
1 tsp ghee / oil if vegan
1.5 tsp mustard seeds (rai)
1 tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp red chilli powder
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp garam masala 
1 tsp aamchur powder
 pinch of salt
2 tbsp water
coriander leaves to garnish

Method:

- Start by boiling, peeling and then chopping your potatoes into your favorite size pieces
- in a pan, add in your ghee / oil followed by mustard seeds and let them pop.
- add in your potatoes and coat them lightly follow that up with haldi, red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala and aamchur powder. 
- toss this together on medium high heat. PRO TIP: you can add in little water here to mix the masalas better and gives you a crispier crust on the potatoes as it fries.
- add in coriander leaves and serve it fresh :)
